newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Singapore government securities ended narrowly mixed on Tuesday in moderate trade on interbank and retail interest, dealers said.
"Government securities ended narrowly mixed today on some speculative trade despite another hike in the interbank rate. Volume was moderate," a local dealer said.
In treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 2.68/2.63 percent compared with Monday's yield of 2.60/2.50 percent and one-year at a yield of 2.58/2.53 percent against 2.60/2.50 percent.
Among bonds, April 1999 was unchanged from Monday's close of S$98.60/98.70.
May 2002 ended at S$99.55/99.65 versus Monday's close of S$99.60/99.70 and June 2003 at S$94.65/94.75 against S$94.70/94.80.
The overnight interbank offered rate rose to 2-3/8 2-1/4 percent from Monday's close of 1-7/8 1-3/4 percent.
